method: Same fixed 9000 clips, cached features, normalized prepared-input protocol and calibrated p_singapore >= 0.50 rule as 24 October. Frozen joblibs; no fitting or threshold tuning.
limitation: 25 October models were trained on unnormalized float32 audio; this is a direct comparison on the previous normalized benchmark, not an evaluation of their native preprocessing pipeline. Raw Part 2 and SVM65 preparation ablations are reported separately.
